harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «الناس» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the clause «اتقوا» is the response to the vocative, resumptive, and so is the clause «إن زلزلة ...».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «يوم» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تذهل»; the preposition phrase «عمَّا» is attached to «تذهل»; «سُكارى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الناس». The wāw in «وما هم» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is a ḥāl of «الناس»; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما», which operates like laysa. The clause «ولكن عذاب الله شديد» is conjoined to an implied (muqaddar) resumptive clause, i.e.: all this is light, but the punishment of Allah is severe.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «ومن الناس من يجادل» is resumptive; «مَن» is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; the preposition phrase «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يجادل»; «مريد» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «شيطان».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: (كتب عليه أنه من تولاه) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The hāʾ in «أنه» is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the conditional clause is the khabar (predicate) of «أنه»; «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «تولاه» is a khabar. The clause «يضلُّه» is the khabar of the second «أنه», and the second interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ, i.e.: فإضلاله واقع (then his misguiding is certain); the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause «فإضلاله واقع» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: (إن كنتم في ريب من البعث) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is the response to the vocative, resumptive. The genitive maṣdar «لنبيِّن لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خلقناكم»; the clause «ونُقِرّ» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «إلى أجل» is attached to «نقرّ»; His saying «مسمى» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أجل». «طفلا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «نخرجكم», and it is singular because it is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun), like الرضا and العدل. The interpreted maṣdar «لتبلغوا» is genitive, attached to an omitted verb conjoined to the clause «نخرجكم», i.e.: ثم نعمِّركم لتبلغوا (then We give you life so that you reach). «لكيلا»: the lām is a preposition and «كي» puts the verb in the accusative; the interpreted maṣdar «لكيلا يعلم» is genitive, attached to «يرد», and «شيئا» is the object of «عِلْم». The clause «وترى» is conjoined to the clause «إنا خلقناكم», and the conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «وترى الأرض». His saying «هامدة»: a ḥāl of «الأرض».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «ذلك بأن الله هو الحق» is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «ذلك»; «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; and the second interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the first.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The interpreted maṣdar «وأن الساعة ...» is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar, and the clause «لا ريب فيها» is a second khabar (predicate) of «أنَّ». The preposition phrase «في القبور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «ومن الناس من يجادل» is conjoined to «من الناس من يجادل» in verse (3). The preposition phrase «بغير علم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يجادل».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «ثاني» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of {يُجَادِلُ}; the maṣdar «ليضل» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يُجَادِلُ}; the clause «له في الدنيا خزي» is a ḥāl of the agent of {يُجَادِلُ}; the preposition phrase «في الدنيا» is attached to a ḥāl of «خزي»; and the clause «نذيقه» is conjoined to the clause «له في الدنيا خزي».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «بما»: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «ما» is a relative noun, genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «ذلك بما قدَّمت» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) of an implied (muqaddar) verb of saying, i.e.: قائلين له (saying to him), and this saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «نذيقه». The maṣdar «وأن الله ليس بظلام» is conjoined to «ما». The faʿʿāl pattern here is for attribution (nasab), i.e.: not one possessing injustice. The lām in «للعبيد» is redundant (zāʾida) for strengthening (taqwiya), and «العبيد» is the object of «ظلام».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «ومن الناس من يعبد» is conjoined to the clause {وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ} in verse (8). The preposition phrase «على حرف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يعبد». The clause «فإن أصابه خير» is conjoined to the clause «ومن الناس من يعبد»; the preposition phrase «على وجهه» is attached to a ḥāl of the agent of «انقلب»; the clause «خسر الدنيا» is a ḥāl of the agent of «انقلب». The clause «ذلك هو الخسران» is resumptive: «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) is «الخسران», and «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «يدعو» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; the clause «ذلك هو الضلال» is resumptive, and «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «يدعو» is resumptive. «لمَن ضرّه»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida) in the object, for emphasis (taʾkīd), and «مَن» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: يدعو مَنْ ضرُّه أقرب (he calls one whose harm is nearer); «ضرّه أقرب» are a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقرب». This view is supported by the reading of ʿAbd Allāh [Translator's note: Ibn Masʿūd]: «يدعو مَن ضرُّه أقرب». The clause «ضرُّه أقرب» is the ṣila (relative clause). The lām in «لبئس» occurs in the response to an oath, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the one specified (al-makhṣūṣ) is omitted, its implied form being: هو.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «جنات» is the second object, and the clause «تجري» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جنات».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «مَن» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «كان» is the khabar (predicate). «أنْ» is lightened from the heavy one (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the maṣdar «أَنْ لن ينصره» stands in place of the two objects of ẓanna. The clause «يظن» is the khabar of kāna, and the clause «لن ينصره» is the khabar of the lightened «أن». The clause «فليمدد» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the lām is for command, and the verb with it is jussive (majzūm). The clause «هل يُذْهبن» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative; «ما» is a relative noun, the object of «يُذْهبن».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «وكذلك»: the wāw is resumptive, and the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: أنزلناه إنزالا مثل ذلك الإنزال (We sent it down a sending down like that sending down). The clause «أنزلناه» is resumptive; «آيات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ; and the maṣdar «وأن الله يهدي» is conjoined to the hāʾ in «أنزلناه».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «إن الله يفصل» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن الذين»; the two adverbs «بينهم» and «يوم» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يفصل».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: (ألم تر أن الله يسجد له) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «تر», and the preposition phrase «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause); the preposition phrase «من الناس» is attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of «كثير». His saying «وكثير»: conjoined to the preceding «كثير», and the clause «حقَّ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كثير». The clause «ومن يهن» is resumptive; «مَن» is a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «فما له من مكرم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida); «مُكْرِم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition phrase «له» is attached to the khabar (predicate). The clause «إن الله يفعل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: «هذان خصمان»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause «اختصموا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «خصمان». The clause «فالذين كفروا ...» is conjoined to the resumptive one, «هذان خصمان», and the clause «قطِّعَت» is the khabar of the relative noun. The preposition phrase «من نار» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «ثياب»; the clause «يُصَبُّ مِنْ فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ الْحَمِيم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «لهم».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «يُصهر» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of {الْحَمِيمُ}; the preposition phrase «في بطونهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause); His saying «والجلود»: a noun conjoined to «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «ولهم مقامع» is conjoined to the clause {يُصَبُّ}; the preposition phrase «من حديد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مقامع».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «كل» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعيدوا», and «ما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun); the implied form is: they are returned into it at every time of wanting. The clause «أعيدوا» is resumptive, and the maṣdar «أن يخرجوا» is the object of «أرادوا». «من غم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, a badal (substitute) of «منها», a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl), with the pronoun implied (muqaddar), the implied form being: «من غمها» (from its anguish). The clause «ذوقوا» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) of an implied verb of saying, i.e.: the angels say to them, and the implied saying is conjoined to the clause «أعيدوا».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «جنات» is the second object; the clause «تجري» is a naʿt (adjective); the clause «يحلَّون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative noun; the preposition phrase «من أساور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «أساور» [Translator's note: so in the source]; «لؤلؤا» is a noun conjoined to the position of «من أساور»; the clause «ولباسهم حرير» is conjoined to the clause «يحلون»; and the preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to a ḥāl of «لباسهم».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The preposition phrase «من القول» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الطيب».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «ويصدون» is conjoined to the clause «كفروا»; «والمسجد» is conjoined to «سبيل»; the relative noun is a second naʿt (adjective); and the preposition phrase «للناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. «سواء» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الناس»; «العاكف» is the fāʿil (agent) of «سواء»; the prepositional phrase is attached to «العاكف»; «والباد» is conjoined to «العاكف», nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the dropped yāʾ. His saying «ومَن»: the wāw is resumptive; «مَن» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the object of «يُرد» is omitted, i.e.: تعدِّيًا (a transgression). The preposition phrase «بإلحاد» is attached to a ḥāl of the object, i.e.: accompanied by deviation; the preposition phrase «بظلم» is a badal (substitute) of «بإلحاد».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: His saying «وإذ بوَّأنا»: the wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, the object of an implied (muqaddar) «اذكر» (remember); and a past verb that includes the meaning of «بَيَّنَّا» (We made clear). The clause «وإذ بوأنا» is resumptive, and the clause «بوأنا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «مكان» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أنْ» is explicative (tafsīriyya); «لا» is prohibitive; and the clause «لا تشرك» is explicative.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «وأذِّن» is conjoined to the clause «طهِّر», and the clause «يأتوك» is the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition. «رجالا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw; the preposition phrase «وعلى كل ضامر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied ḥāl, i.e.: on foot and being on every…; the clause «يأتين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كل ضامر».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The interpreted maṣdar «ليشهدوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يَأْتُوكَ}; the preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «منافع»; the preposition phrase «على ما رزقهم» is attached to «يذكروا»; the preposition phrase «من بهيمة» is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative noun; the clause «فكلوا منها» is resumptive; «الفقير» is a naʿt of the object.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The lām in «ليقضوا» is the lām of command, which puts the verb in the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «ذلك»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: الأمر ذلك (the matter is that). The clause «ومن يعظم» is resumptive; «مَن» is conditional, mubtadaʾ, and the clause «يعظِّم» is its khabar. The prepositional phrase and the adverb are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير». The clause «وأُحِلَّت» is resumptive; «إلا ما يتلى»: a relative noun, excepted. The clause «فاجتنبوا» is resumptive, and the preposition phrase «من الأوثان» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الرجس».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «حنفاء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent pronoun in «اجتنبوا»; the preposition phrase «لله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حنفاء»; «غير» is a second ḥāl; the preposition phrase «به» is attached to «مشركين». The clause «ومن يشرك بالله» is resumptive; «مَن» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject); «كأنما» is a restraining particle (kāffa) and the restrained one (makfūfa); the clause «فكأنما خرَّ» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «فتخطفه» is conjoined to the clause «خَرَّ», and the clause «أو تهوي» is conjoined to the clause «تخطفه».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «ذلك»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: الأمر ذلك (the matter is that). The wāw is resumptive; «مَن» is conditional, mubtadaʾ; the clause «يعظِّم» is the khabar; and the clause «فإنها من تقوى» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to the "being established" (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached; the preposition phrase «إلى أجل» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «منافع»; the clause «ثم محلُّها إلى البيت» is conjoined to the resumptive one, «لكم فيها منافع».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: His saying «ولكل»: the wāw is resumptive, the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object, and «منسكًا» is the first object. The interpreted maṣdar «ليذكروا» is genitive, attached to «جعلنا»; the preposition phrase «من بهيمة» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما». The clause «فإلهكم إله» is resumptive; the clause «فله أسلموا» is conjoined to the clause «إلهكم إله واحد»; and the clause «وَبَشِّر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «المخبتين»; «إذا» is a conditional adverb (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis, and the conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. His saying «والصابرين»: a noun conjoined to {الْمُخْبِتِينَ}, and the prepositional phrase is attached to «الصابرين». «والمقيمي»: a noun conjoined to «الصابرين», and «الصلاة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the muḍāf may take al- because the annexation is verbal (lafẓiyya) and the muḍāf is a plural. The preposition phrase «مما» is attached to the verb «ينفقون», and the clause «ينفقون» is conjoined to the conditional clause, which is the ṣila of «الذين».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: His saying «والبُدن»: the wāw is resumptive, and «البُدن» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows; the implied (muqaddar) clause is resumptive. The preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition phrase «من شعائر» is attached to the second object of jaʿala; the preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to the "being established" (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached; the clause «لكم فيها خير» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «جعلناها». The clause «فاذكروا» is conjoined to the clause «جعلنا البدن»; «صوافَّ» is a ḥāl of the hāʾ. His saying «فإذا وجبت»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the conditional clause is conjoined to the implied conditional clause «إن نحرتموها» (if you slaughter them); the clause «وجبت» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). His saying «كذلك»: the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi; the implied form is: سخَّرناها تسخيرًا مثل ذلك التسخير (We subjected them a subjecting like that subjecting). The clause «سخَّرناها» is resumptive, and the clause «لعلكم تشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «لحومها» is the fāʿil (agent) placed later; the clause «ولكن يناله» is conjoined to the clause «لن ينال»; the preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «التقوى». «كذلك»: the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: سَخَّرها الله تسخيرًا مثل ذلك التسخير (Allah subjected them a subjecting like that subjecting). The clause «سخَّرها» is resumptive; the genitive maṣdar «لتكبروا» is attached to «سخرها»; «ما» in His saying «ما هداكم» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the genitive maṣdar is attached to «تكبِّروا»; the clause «وبَشِّر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The clause «إن الله لا يحب» is resumptive; «كفور» is a naʿt (adjective) of «خوَّان».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The preposition phrase «للذين» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the maṣdar «بأنهم ظلموا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أذن». The clause «وإن الله ... لقدير» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «على نصرهم» is attached to «قدير»; and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) is in the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «الذين» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هم (they). The preposition phrase «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw; «إلا» is for exception; the interpreted maṣdar «أن يقولوا» is a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ). The conditional clause is resumptive: «لولا» is a particle of impossibility because of existence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), and «دَفْع» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing); «بعضهم» is a badal (substitute) of «الناس»; the preposition phrase «ببعض» is attached to a ḥāl of «الناس»; the clause «لهدِّمت» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «يذكر» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مساجد»; His saying «كثيرًا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «ولينصرنَّ» is the response to an oath, and the oath with its response is a resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The relative noun is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «هم الذين» (they are those who); the conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the clause «ولله عاقبة الأمور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: His saying «وقوم»: a noun conjoined to the preceding {قَوْمُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «وأصحاب» is a noun conjoined to {قَوْمُ}. The clause «فأمليت» is conjoined to the clause {وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ}. His saying «فكيف»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of kāna; «نكير» is the noun of kāna, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ; and the clause «فكيف كان نكير» is conjoined to the clause «ثم أخذتهم».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: His saying «فكأين»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «كأين» is an allusive noun for number (ism kināya ʿan ʿadad), mubtadaʾ (subject); the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كأين»; the clause «أهلكناها» is the khabar (predicate) of «كأين»; the clause «وهي ظالمة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «أهلكناها»; and the clause «فهي خاوية» is conjoined to the clause «أهلكناها». His saying «وبئر»: a noun conjoined to «قرية».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: His saying «أفلم يسيروا»: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is resumptive. The fāʾ in «فتكون» is causative (sababiyya), and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the accusative; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted (mutaṣayyad) from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there be a travelling, and then a having of hearts. The clause «يسمعون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «آذان»; the clause «فإنها لا تعمى» is resumptive; the clause «ولكن تعمى» is conjoined to the clause «لا تعمى الأبصار»; the preposition phrase «في الصدور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The clause «ويستعجلونك» is resumptive; the clause «ولن يخلف» is conjoined to the resumptive one; the clause «وإن يومًا ...» is resumptive; the adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «يومًا».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: His saying «وكأين»: the wāw is resumptive, and an allusive noun for number (ism kināya ʿan ʿadad), mubtadaʾ (subject); the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كأين»; the clause «أمليت» is the khabar (predicate); the clause «وهي ظالمة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun hāʾ in «لها»; the clause «أخذتها» is conjoined to the clause «أمليت»; and the clause «وإليَّ المصير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «الناس» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the clause «إنما أنا نذير» is the response to the vocative, resumptive; «مبين» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «فالذين آمنوا ...» is conjoined to the clause (إِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ), and the clause «لهم مغفرة» is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «والذين سعوا ...» is conjoined to the clause «الذين آمنوا ...». «معاجزين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «سعوا», and the clause «أولئك أصحاب الجحيم» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين سعوا».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «وما أرسلنا» is resumptive; «رسول» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the conditional clause is a naʿt (adjective) of «نبي»; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; and the clause «والله عليم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The genitive interpreted maṣdar «ليجعل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يُحْكِمُ}; «فتنة» is the second object of «يجعل»; the clause «في قلوبهم مرض» is the ṣila (relative clause); «القاسية» is a noun conjoined to «الذين», and «قلوبهم» is the fāʿil (agent) of «القاسية»; the clause «وإن الظالمين لفي شقاق» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: His saying «وليعلم»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the genitive interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar and is attached to (mutaʿalliq) what that is attached to. The maṣdar «أنه الحق» stands in place of the two objects of yaʿlamu; the preposition phrase «من ربك» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الحق». His saying «فيؤمنوا»: a verb conjoined to «يعلم». The clause «وإن الله لهاد» is resumptive; «هاد» is the khabar (predicate), nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the dropped yāʾ; the preposition phrase «إلى صراط» is attached to «هاد».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The clause «ولا يزال» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «في مرية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the preposition phrase «منه» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «مرية». The maṣdar «حتى تأتيهم» is genitive by «حتى», attached to the "being established" (istiqrār) to which «في مرية» is attached; «بغتة» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «يوم»: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the "being established" (istiqrār) attached to the khabar (predicate); «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn is a compensation for an omitted clause. The preposition phrase «لله» is attached to the khabar; the clause «يحكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the name of Majesty; and the relative clause is conjoined to the clause «يحكم».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «أولئك لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of the second mubtadaʾ «أولئك» [Translator's note: so in the source], and the clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. The fāʾ in «فأولئك» is redundant (zāʾida), likening the relative noun to a condition, and the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ, «عذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: (والذين هاجروا في سبيل الله) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The relative clause is conjoined to the preceding relative clause; «رزقًا» is the second object; the clause «ليرزقنَّهم» is the response to the oath, and the oath clause with its response is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «والذين»; the clause «وإن الله لهو خير الرازقين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «ليدخلَنَّهم» is a badal (substitute) of the clause {لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ}; «مُدْخلا» is the second object; the clause «يرضونه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مدخلا»; the clause «وإن الله لعليم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «ذلك» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: الأمر ذلك (the matter is that). The wāw in «ومَن» is resumptive; «مَن» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause «عاقب» is a khabar; the clause «لينصرنَّه» is the response to the oath, and the oath clause with its response is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «مَن».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the genitive interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); and the second maṣdar, «وأن الله سميع», is conjoined to the first maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the genitive interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). «ما» is a relative noun, the noun of «أن»; the preposition phrase «من دونه» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; «هو» is a mubtadaʾ and «الباطل» its khabar; the second maṣdar is conjoined to the first. «هو» is a pronoun of separation, and «الكبير» is a second khabar; the maṣdar «وأن الله هو العلي» is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: (ألم تر أن الله أنزل من السماء ماء) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «تر»; the clause «فتصبح» is conjoined to the clause «أنزل»; the clause «إن الله لطيف» is resumptive, and «خبير» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The clause «له ما في السماوات» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause); the clause «لهو الغني» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ»; «الحميد» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: (ألم تر أن الله سخر لكم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «تر»; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition phrase «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); the clause «تجري» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الفلك»; the preposition phrase «بأمره» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «تجري», i.e.: being accompanied. The maṣdar «أن تقع» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: for fear; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the preposition phrase «بإذنه» is attached to a ḥāl of the agent of «تقع», i.e.: accompanied by His permission.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is resumptive, and so is the clause «إن الإنسان لكفور».

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The preposition phrase «لكل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object, and «منسكا» is the first object; the clause «جعلنا» is resumptive; the clause «هم ناسكوه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «منسكا». His saying «فلا ينازعنك»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the nūn is for emphasis (tawkīd), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «فلا ينازعنك» is conjoined to the clause «جعلنا»; the dropped wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the preposition phrase «في الأمر» is attached to the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «وإن جادلوك» is conjoined to the clause «لا ينازعُنَّك»; «ما» in His saying «بما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: (الله يحكم بينكم يوم القيامة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The two adverbs are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: (ألم تعلم أن الله يعلم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of ʿalima; the preposition phrase «في السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); the preposition phrase «على الله» is attached to «يسير».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). His saying «وما ليس»: the relative noun is conjoined to the preceding relative noun; the preposition phrase «به» is attached to a ḥāl of «عِلْم», and «عِلْم» is the noun of laysa. The clause «وما للظالمين من نصير» is resumptive; «ما» is negating and inoperative (muhmala); «نصير» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {وَيَعْبُدُونَ}. «بينات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آياتنا»; the clause «تعرف» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «يكادون» is a ḥāl of the relative noun, and the ḥāl may come from the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) here because the muḍāf is a part of the muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «يسطون» is the khabar (predicate) of yakādu. The clause «قل» is resumptive, and the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: أأخاطبكم (shall I address you?), and the clause «أفأنبئكم» is conjoined to the implied object of the speech. «النار» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ in «وعدها» is the second object, and the relative noun is the first object; the clause «النار وعدَها» is explicative of «الشر», and the clause «وعدها» is the khabar of «النار». The clause «وبئس المصير» is resumptive, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e.: the Fire.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The clause «ضرب» is the response to the vocative, resumptive; the clause «فاستمعِوا» is conjoined to the clause «ضُرِبَ مَثل». The preposition phrase «مِن دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied (muqaddar) object, i.e.: you call upon them, they being other than Allah. The clause «لن يخلقوا» is the khabar (predicate). The wāw in «ولو» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle; the clause «ولو اجتمعوا له» is a ḥāl of the wāw in «يخلقوا». This wāw conjoins to an implied ḥāl, i.e.: they will not create a fly in any state, even in the state of gathering together; this is for exhausting all states. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of «لو» is omitted, i.e.: they will not create. «شيئًا» is the second object; the clause «وإن يسلبهم» is conjoined to the clause «إن الذين»; and the clause «ضعف الطالب» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The clause «ما قدروا» is resumptive; «حق» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The preposition phrase «من الملائكة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يصطفي», and the preposition phrase «ومن الناس» is conjoined to the preposition phrase «من الملائكة» and is attached to what that is attached to.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «يعلم» is a third khabar (predicate) of {إِنَّ}. «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بين» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause). The clause «ترجع» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «الذين» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), and the clause «لعلكم تفلحون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: «حق» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «هو اجتباكم» is resumptive, and the clause «وما جعل» is conjoined to the clause «هو اجتباكم». «حرج» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition phrase «في الدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعل»; the preposition phrase «عليكم» is attached to the second object. «ملة» is the mafʿūl bihi of an implied (muqaddar) «أعني» (I mean), and «إبراهيم» is a badal (substitute) of «أبيكم». The clause «هو سمَّاكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إبراهيم», and «سمَّى» is transitive to two objects: the kāf and «المسلمين». The preposition phrase «من قبل» is attached to the verb, and it is indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation. His saying «وفي هذا»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the prepositional phrase is attached to «سمَّاكم»; the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and an abrogating (nāsikh) imperfect verb in the accusative by a concealed «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to «سمَّاكم». The preposition phrase «عليكم» is attached to «شهيدا», and the preposition phrase «على الناس» is attached to «شهداء». The clause «فأقيموا» is resumptive; the clause «هو مولاكم» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause «فنعم المولى» is resumptive: a past verb of praise and its fāʿil (agent), and the one specified (al-makhṣūṣ) is omitted, i.e.: Allah.
